summary: 2026-08-02 21:50 PDT — The behavioral changes satisfy AC1–AC6, but the branch violates the approved scope-containment criterion because it adds an unlisted review artifact.

findings.title: Unlisted approach-review artifact violates AC7
findings.claim: This added file is not among the only permitted story artifacts named by AC7, which lists only frame-falsification-plan.md and frame-falsification-plan.design.json. The branch therefore fails an explicit acceptance criterion and cannot merge as specified.
findings.suggestion: Remove this artifact from the branch, or obtain Thomas's approval to amend AC7 so workflow-generated approach-review artifacts are explicitly permitted.
